Name: Exorcist
Description: Drag and drop bodies. Prayer requires min(3, all unreported bodies on the map), with at least one body, in a valid nearby group. BodyGroupRules requires pairwise spacing within 1.5 units. A successful prayer privately reveals one qualifying killer name and role at the next meeting. Only actual history entries for the analyzed victims qualify; the killer must have an Impostor or Neutral Killing role. Failed conditions do not consume Prayer.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Composter
Description: The Composter wins with the Crewmates but can kill indirectly. Their Place Trap button creates an invisible, single-use trap at their feet. The Composter is immune to their own traps. Other players cannot see them.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Furas
Description: Furas wins with the Crew. Place up to the configured number of pet spawn points, choose one, then control a walking fox for a limited time. The fox uses normal movement controls and moves at 1.25 times normal player speed by default. It cannot cross walls or use vents, ladders, platforms or doors. Attacks respect shields and Dirtek protection. By default, killing a Crewmate permanently disables all Furas abilities. Options control spawn count, placement cooldown, control duration and cooldown, speed multiplier, attack range and cooldown, initial attack delay, kills per control, visibility, marker display, Comms blocking, meeting persistence and the Crewmate penalty.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Bandit
Description: Choose a living player during a round. Both roles stay unchanged through the next meeting. After it ends, you borrow their current role for one round. After the following meeting, both original roles return. If either player dies before activation, the selection is cancelled. You win with the Crewmates.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Necromancer
Description: Control a corpse while your own body stays still, with one attack per control. Alternatively, animate a corpse to follow its killer around obstacles. Its owner remains dead. Timers, death and meetings end control. Settings govern uses, speed, reporting and Crewmate attacks.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Doctor
Description: Mark players to give them a one-hit shield. The mark that unlocks your reveal grants no shield. Your shields vanish when you die. An early reveal disables marking until the next meeting. Only marked living Crewmates count toward your reveal. After revealing, you become protected and can no longer mark. Voting can still eject you when enabled. You win with the Crewmates.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Wladca
Description: Empower activates Wladca's selected powers for the configured duration. Each power can be switched on or off separately in TOU-Marmo role settings. The role has its own crown and Empower icons.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Hugger
Description: Hug kills immediately in the world, using the standard special-murder animation and a configured body-disappearance chance. In meetings, one non-Impostor hug per game requests an immediate meeting kill. One Impostor hug per game grants Double Shot while preserving Assassin. The latter still depends on the unresolved Double/Triple Shot retirement decision.
WinCondition: Win with the Impostors, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Sweets
Description: Give flowers to non-Impostor-aligned living players. After the configured quota, the same button becomes Pollinate. Each flower holder independently rolls the kill percentage; all flowers and the counter reset afterwards, allowing further cycles. Flower state is currently shared statically across Sweets instances: multi-Sweets lobbies need testing.
WinCondition: Win with the Impostors, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Dirtek
Description: Dirtek automatically receives one random living player at the start of the game. Protection is passive, permanent and has no cooldown or activation button. The target cannot be changed. The target dies when Dirtek dies. This protective Neutral is listed under Neutral Benign.
WinCondition: Dirtek and the assigned protected player must both be alive at game end (SoulguardRole.DidWin). This is a Neutral survival condition.

Name: Gambler
Description: Gambler places marks during a meeting. Marks arm when the next round begins; marked players who are already dead do not count. The first marked death outside a meeting grants one shot. A successful Cash Out kill fulfills Gambler's win condition.
WinCondition: Successfully kill with the earned Cash Out shot; HasWon is latched. The end-game trigger additionally requires Gambler to be alive.

Name: Barszcz
Description: Barszcz is a Neutral Killing role. After Barszcz kills, every player receives an arrow pointing to the new body. At the same time, Barszcz trades positions with the farthest living player. The arrow remains until the body disappears or a meeting begins.
WinCondition: Role-specific condition: see the description and linked WinConditionMet/DidWin implementation. No generic Neutral team victory is implied.

Name: Engineer
Description: The Engineer is a Crewmate role that can fix one sabotage per game, from anywhere on the map.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Crewmate (mode-specific variant)
Description: Town of Polus base Crewmate variant; uses the mode-specific Crewmate mechanics and team victory rules.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Haunter
Description: The Haunter is a Crewmate Ghost who can do tasks. They will appear as a transparent player. If they finish all their tasks, all living players will see who the Impostors are. However, if an Impostor clicks them first, they will become a normal ghost. Impostors get a warning shortly before and when the Haunter finishes their tasks.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Chameleon
Description: The Chameleon is a Crewmate that can temporarily go invisible to hide from the seeker.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Mystic
Description: The Mystic is a Crewmate that gets an arrow pointing to every kill.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Snitch
Description: The Snitch is a Crewmate that decreases the time remaining quicker than other players with tasks, but at the cost of outing themselves to the seeker.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Aurial
Description: The Aurial is a Crewmate Investigative role that will be alerted whenever a player near them uses one of their abilities.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Forensic
Description: The Forensic is a Crewmate Investigative role that can inspect crime scenes and examine players to see if they were at the crime scene, flashing red if they were there.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Investigator
Description: The Investigator is a Crewmate Investigative role can see player's footprints throughout the game. Swooped players' footprints will not be visible to the Investigator.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Lookout
Description: The Lookout is a Crewmate Investigative role that can watch other players during rounds. During meetings, they will see all roles or players who interact with each watched player.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Medium
Description: The Medium is a Crewmate Investigative role that can temporarily release their spirit. They can pass through walls and see ghosts, but leave their body unprotected.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Mystic
Description: The Mystic is a Crewmate Investigative role that gets an alert when someone dies.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Seer
Description: The Seer is a Crewmate Investigative role that can reveal the alliance of other players.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Snitch
Description: The Snitch is a Crewmate Investigative role that can reveal the Impostors to themselves by finishing all their tasks. Upon completing all tasks, the Impostors will be revealed to the Snitch with an arrow and their red name.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Sonar
Description: The Sonar is a Crewmate Investigative role that can track other players to see their general position across the map, getting colored arrows towards all tracked players.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Spy
Description: The Spy is a Crewmate Investigative role that gains extra information on the admin table. They not only see how many people are in a room, but see who is in every room.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Trapper
Description: The Trapper is a Crewmate Investigative role that can place traps around the map. If someone stays in it for enough time and enough players go through, they will get a list of their roles in the next meeting in random order.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Deputy
Description: The Deputy is a Crewmate Killing role that can camp other players. Once a camped player dies, the Deputy is alerted to their death. The following meeting, the Deputy may then attempt to shoot the killer of the camped player. If successful the killer dies and if not nothing happens.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Hunter
Description: The Hunter is a Crewmate Killing role that can stalk players during the round. If a stalked player uses an ability, they can be killed by the Hunter at any point in the game, even Crew. However, if the Hunter kills a caught Crewmate in the same round they were caught, the Hunter will leave in shame at the end of the next meeting.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Officer
Description: The Officer is a Crewmate Killing role that can shoot players with limited ammo. They must load bullets, which only last one round unless they are added within 10 seconds.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Sheriff
Description: The Sheriff is a Crewmate Killing role that can shoot a player to attempt to kill them. If Sheriff doesn't die to misfire, they will lose the ability to shoot.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Veteran
Description: The Veteran is a Crewmate Killing role that can go on alert and kill anyone who interacts with them.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Vigilante
Description: The Vigilante is a Crewmate Killing role that can guess roles of players in meetings. If they guess correctly, the other player will die. If not, they will die.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Jailor
Description: The Jailor is a Crewmate Power role that can jail other players. During a meeting, the Jailor can choose to execute their jailed player. (Unless the Jailor is an Imitator)
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Mayor
Description: The Mayor is a Crewmate Power role that gains three votes and is revealed to all players, also changing their look in meetings.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Monarch
Description: The Monarch is a Crewmate Power role that can hand out additional votes to other players.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Politician
Description: The Politician is a Crewmate Power role that can reveal themselves to the crew as the Mayor, given that they have campaigned at least half of the crewmates.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Prosecutor
Description: The Prosecutor is a Crewmate Power role that can Exile a player, applying five votes to a player of their choosing. They can also see who voted for whom, even if they're anonymous.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Swapper
Description: The Swapper is a Crewmate Power that can swap the votes of two players in a meeting. Their meeting vote areas will be swapped visually, and the votes will be swapped. If player 1 received the most votes, and you swap them with player 2, player 2 will now be ejected instead.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Time Lord
Description: The Time Lord is a Crewmate Power role that can rewind time, forcing every player to retrace their steps for a short duration.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Altruist
Description: The Altruist is a Crewmate Protective role that can revive dead crewmates, but prevents meetings being called by themselves or the crewmates they revive.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Cleric
Description: The Cleric is a Crewmate Protective that can protect crewmates by negating their negative effects, as well as placing barriers on them to prevent interactions.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Medic
Description: The Medic is a Crewmate Protective role that can give a Shield to a player.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Mirrorcaster
Description: The Mirrorcaster is a Crewmate Protective role that can cast a Magic Mirror on a player to protect them. If attacked directly, the Mirrorcaster can then unleash onto another player.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Oracle
Description: The Oracle is a Crewmate Protective role that can get another player to confess (revealing their faction with [revealAccuracy]% accuracy if the Oracle dies) or can protect a player from meeting abilities.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Warden
Description: The Warden is a Crewmate Protective role that can fortify players to prevent them from being interacted with.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Barkeeper
Description: The Barkeeper is a Crewmate Support role that can drink with others to roleblock them. They may also spill a drink to speed or slow down players.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Engineer
Description: The Engineer is a Crewmate Support role that can vent and fix sabotages remotely.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Imitator
Description: The Imitator is a Crewmate Support role that can select a dead crewmate to imitate their role until they change targets. Certain roles are inaccessible if there are multiple living imitators.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Plumber
Description: Drop a nail into a nearby vent. The vent records eligible entries and triggers the configured single-use trap threshold, then removes the trap. Task progression can replenish uses. The installed role no longer builds vent walls. Its standard Engineer-style vent access is retained.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Sentry
Description: The Sentry is a Crewmate Support role that can deploy cameras around the map that function like Security cameras.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Transporter
Description: The Transporter is a Crewmate Support role that can transport two players, dead or alive, to swap their locations.
WinCondition: Win with the Crewmates, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Bomber
Description: The Bomber is an Impostor Killing role that can drop a bomb on the map, which detonates after [detonateDelay] second(s).
WinCondition: Role-specific condition: see the description and linked WinConditionMet/DidWin implementation. No generic Neutral team victory is implied.

Name: Escapist
Description: The Escapist is an Impostor Concealing role that can mark a location and then recall (teleport) to that location.
WinCondition: Role-specific condition: see the description and linked WinConditionMet/DidWin implementation. No generic Neutral team victory is implied.

Name: Glitch
Description: The Glitch is a Neutral Killing role that wins by being the last killer alive. They can Mimic into another player, or they can hack a player.
WinCondition: Be the last killer alive and satisfy the Glitch end-game population checks.

Name: Grenadier
Description: The Grenadier is an Impostor Concealing role that can throw down a grenade that will blind all other players
WinCondition: Role-specific condition: see the description and linked WinConditionMet/DidWin implementation. No generic Neutral team victory is implied.

Name: Juggernaut
Description: The Juggernaut is a Neutral Killing role that wins by being the last killer alive. For each kill they get, their kill cooldown gets reduced.
WinCondition: Be the last killer alive and satisfy its end-game population checks.

Name: Outcast
Description: The Outcast is a basic killer, with the ability to vent and being able to see farther than any other killer.
WinCondition: Role-specific condition: see the description and linked WinConditionMet/DidWin implementation. No generic Neutral team victory is implied.

Name: Scavenger
Description: The Scavenger is an Impostor Killing role that gets new targets after every kill and when the round starts. If they kill their target, they get a reduced kill cooldown, but if they don't, their cooldown is increased significantly.
WinCondition: Role-specific condition: see the description and linked WinConditionMet/DidWin implementation. No generic Neutral team victory is implied.

Name: Vampire
Description: The Vampire is a Neutral Killing role that wins by being the last killer(s) alive. They can bite, changing others into Vampires, or kill players.
WinCondition: The surviving Vampire faction must be the last killer faction and meet its end-game population checks.

Name: Venerer
Description: The Venerer is an Impostor Concealing role that can kill players to gain new abilities, preventing others from catching them! However, the ability will be used immediately as they receive it, which will stack up.
WinCondition: Role-specific condition: see the description and linked WinConditionMet/DidWin implementation. No generic Neutral team victory is implied.

Name: Veteran
Description: The Veteran is a Crewmate Killing role that can go on alert and kill anyone who interacts with them.
WinCondition: Role-specific condition: see the description and linked WinConditionMet/DidWin implementation. No generic Neutral team victory is implied.

Name: Werewolf
Description: The Werewolf is a Neutral Killing role that wins by being the last killer alive. They can go on a rampage to gain the ability to kill.
WinCondition: Be the last killer alive and satisfy its end-game population checks.

Name: Spectator
Description: You don't participate in-game nor interact with players. All you can do is watch.
WinCondition: Role-specific condition: see the description and linked WinConditionMet/DidWin implementation. No generic Neutral team victory is implied.

Name: Swooper
Description: The Swooper is an Impostor role that can go invisible at any time to either hide or run away from kills. However, they cannot vent.
WinCondition: Win with the Impostors, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Impostor (mode-specific variant)
Description: Town of Polus base Impostor variant; uses the mode-specific Impostor mechanics and team victory rules.
WinCondition: Win with the Impostors, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Eclipsal
Description: The Eclipsal is an Impostor Concealing role that can hinder the vision of all crewmates and neutrals alike, given that they are near the Eclipsal.
WinCondition: Win with the Impostors, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Escapist
Description: The Escapist is an Impostor Concealing role that can mark a location and then recall (teleport) to that location.
WinCondition: Win with the Impostors, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Grenadier
Description: The Grenadier is an Impostor Concealing role that can throw down a grenade that will blind all other players
WinCondition: Win with the Impostors, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Morphling
Description: The Morphling is an Impostor Concealing role that can Sample a player and Morph into it's appearance.
WinCondition: Win with the Impostors, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Swooper
Description: The Swooper is an Impostor Concealing role that can temporarily turn invisible.
WinCondition: Win with the Impostors, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Venerer
Description: The Venerer is an Impostor Concealing role that can kill players to gain new abilities, preventing others from catching them! However, the ability will be used immediately as they receive it, which will stack up.
WinCondition: Win with the Impostors, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Ambusher
Description: The Ambusher is an Impostor Killing role that can pursue a player, getting an arrow to them. They may ambush the closest player next to them. If they manage to kill the player, they will drag their body into the shadows, teleporting back with the Ambusher.
WinCondition: Win with the Impostors, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Bomber
Description: The Bomber is an Impostor Killing role that can drop a bomb on the map, which detonates after [detonateDelay] second(s).
WinCondition: Win with the Impostors, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Parasite
Description: The Parasite can Overtake nearby non-impostors to take control of their movement. By default, while overtaken, the victim looks like the Parasite and cannot use abilities. You can watch them with a PiP camera and kill them at any time, or wait for the control timer to kill them.
WinCondition: Win with the Impostors, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Scavenger
Description: The Scavenger is an Impostor Killing role that gets new targets after every kill and when the round starts. If they kill their target, they get a reduced kill cooldown, but if they don't, their cooldown is increased significantly.
WinCondition: Win with the Impostors, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Warlock
Description: The Warlock is an Impostor Killing role that can charge up attacks to wipe out the crew quickly.
WinCondition: Win with the Impostors, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Ambassador
Description: The Ambassador is an Impostor Power role that can retrain impostors into other impostor roles.
WinCondition: Win with the Impostors, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Herbalist
Description: The Herbalist is an Impostor Power role that has many abilities tied to one cooldown, either to help Impostors or to affect what others see.
WinCondition: Win with the Impostors, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Puppeteer
Description: The Puppeteer is an Impostor Power role that controls other players to kill for them. When a player is controlled, they must watch as they are forced to kill their fellow crewmates.
WinCondition: Win with the Impostors, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Spellslinger
Description: The Spellslinger is an Impostor Power role that can hex a player, priming them for detonation. Once all non-Impostors are hexed, they may set off a Hex Bomb after a set amount of time to win.
WinCondition: Win with the Impostors, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Traitor
Description: The Traitor is an Impostor Power role that spawns after a meeting, in which the spawn conditions are suitable. The Traitor will always be a crewmate, and they may change to a few select roles.
WinCondition: Win with the Impostors, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Camouflager
Description: The Camouflager is an Impostor that can temporarily make all players appear the same as themselves.
WinCondition: Win with the Impostors, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Blackmailer
Description: The Blackmailer is an Impostor Support role that can stop a player from speaking (marked with [symbol]) in the next meeting
WinCondition: Win with the Impostors, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Bootlegger
Description: The Bootlegger is an Impostor Support role that can drink with others to roleblock them. Once a player is roleblocked three times, they will die of poison.
WinCondition: Win with the Impostors, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Hypnotist
Description: The Hypnotist is an Impostor Support role that can hypnotize players. During a meeting they can release Mass Hysteria, which makes all hypnotized players (marked with [symbol]) have different visuals applied to players the following round.
WinCondition: Win with the Impostors, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Janitor
Description: The Janitor is an Impostor Support role that can clean dead bodies.
WinCondition: Win with the Impostors, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Miner
Description: The Miner is an Impostor Support role that can create vents.
WinCondition: Win with the Impostors, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Undertaker
Description: The Undertaker is an Impostor Support role that can drag dead bodies around the map.
WinCondition: Win with the Impostors, subject to alliance modifiers and the selected game mode.

Name: Serial Killer
Description: The Serial Killer is a Neutral role that has the sole goal of killing every player. If they do not kill the minimum amount of players needed, they will lose.
WinCondition: Role-specific condition: see the description and linked WinConditionMet/DidWin implementation. No generic Neutral team victory is implied.

Name: Spectre
Description: The Spectre is a Neutral Ghost role that wins the game by finishing their tasks before a living player has clicked on them.
WinCondition: Use the haunting/reveal and Spectre end-game rules; a previously confirmed Jester ejection remains a distinct recorded result.

Name: Amnesiac
Description: The Amnesiac is a Neutral Benign role that gains access to a new role from remembering a dead body’s role. Use the role you remember to win the game.
WinCondition: Remember a dead player and follow the resulting role and its victory condition.

Name: Fairy
Description: The Fairy is a Neutral Benign that needs to protect their target (signified by [symbol]) from getting killed/ejected.
WinCondition: Protect the assigned target and follow the Fairy survival/target outcome; the configured target-death transformation can change the role and win condition.

Name: Mercenary
Description: The Mercenary is a Neutral Benign role that can only win by bribing players, allowing them to gain multiple win conditions.
WinCondition: Bribe players to acquire their associated victory conditions; follow the bribe-specific rules in the linked implementation.

Name: Survivor
Description: The Survivor is a Neutral Benign role that just needs to survive until the end of the game.
WinCondition: Be alive when the game ends.

Name: FrenzyGhostRole (mode-specific variant)
Description: Internal Kill Frenzy dead-player wrapper. Its visible description and victory evaluation delegate to the player role recorded before death; it is not an additional independently assigned living role.
WinCondition: Role-specific condition: see the description and linked WinConditionMet/DidWin implementation. No generic Neutral team victory is implied.

Name: Doomsayer
Description: The Doomsayer is a Neutral Evil role that wins by guessing [guessCount] players' roles.
WinCondition: Successfully guess the configured number of players roles.

Name: Executioner
Description: The Executioner is a Neutral Evil role that wins by getting their target (signified by [symbol]) ejected in a meeting.
WinCondition: Have the assigned target ejected according to ExecutionerOptions. Renouncing changes the actual role to Amnesiac and its win rules; changing target does not itself win.

Name: Jester
Description: The Jester is a Neutral Evil role that wins by getting themselves ejected.
WinCondition: Qualifying vote ejection satisfies the Jester result. The configured victory mode controls immediate game end versus haunt/no immediate end. JesterExileRuntime preserves the confirmed voting result across Spectre replacement; ordinary kills, skip and tie do not qualify.

Name: Arsonist
Description: The Arsonist is a Neutral Killing role that wins by being the last killer alive.
WinCondition: Douse and ignite the required remaining players; use the role-specific end-game condition.

Name: Glitch
Description: The Glitch is a Neutral Killing role that wins by being the last killer alive. They can Mimic into another player, or they can hack a player.
WinCondition: Be the last killer alive and satisfy the Glitch end-game population checks.

Name: Juggernaut
Description: The Juggernaut is a Neutral Killing role that wins by being the last killer alive. For each kill they get, their kill cooldown gets reduced.
WinCondition: Be the last killer alive and satisfy its end-game population checks.

Name: Medusa
Description: The Medusa is a Neutral Killing role that forces its victims to stand still and slowly turn into stone. Stoned players that haven't shattered will remain throughout rounds.
WinCondition: Satisfy the Medusa neutral-killer end-game condition; petrification and surviving killers affect its population checks.

Name: Pestilence
Description: The Pestilence is a Neutral Killing role that can kill and is invincible to everything but being exiled or guessing incorrectly. They win by being the last killer alive.
WinCondition: Use the Pestilence neutral-killer victory condition.

Name: Plaguebearer
Description: The Plaguebearer is a Neutral Killing role that needs to infect all other players to turn into the Pestilence.
WinCondition: Spread infection to transform into Pestilence; the transformed role determines victory.

Name: Vampire
Description: The Vampire is a Neutral Killing role that wins by being the last killer(s) alive. They can bite, changing others into Vampires, or kill players.
WinCondition: The surviving Vampire faction must be the last killer faction and meet its end-game population checks.

Name: Werewolf
Description: The Werewolf is a Neutral Killing role that wins by being the last killer alive. They can go on a rampage to gain the ability to kill.
WinCondition: Be the last killer alive and satisfy its end-game population checks.

Name: Chef
Description: The Chef is a Neutral Outlier role that wins with any other faction as long as they have served enough dead bodies to the crew.
WinCondition: Serve the required number of dead bodies; can share another factions victory when that requirement is met.

Name: Inquisitor
Description: The Inquisitor is a Neutral Outlier role that wins if their targets (Heretics) die. The only information provided is their roles, and it's up to the Inquisitor to identify those players (marked with [symbol] to the dead) and get them killed by any means necessary.
WinCondition: Have all assigned Heretic targets die, by any allowed means.
